description: This file declares internal API functions for the Slap Obj Wrapper Object in the Service Logic Aggregation Plane implementation. It includes function prototypes for setting object name, LPC party address, and LPC party name, used internally within the SLAP component.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetObjName
methods.description: Sets the object name for the Slap Owo Object.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetLpcPartyAddr
methods.description: Sets the LPC party address for the Slap Owo Object.

methods.name: SlapOwoSetLpcPartyName
methods.description: Sets the LPC party name for the Slap Owo Object.
